title: The Three Musketeers
author: Alexandre Dumas
summary: Young d'Artagnan travels to Paris to join the king's musketeers and makes friends with Athos, Porthos and Aramis. They soon find themselves in a plot involving the queen's honour and the powerful Cardinal Richelieu.
readIf: you want a swashbuckling, funny and fast-moving adventure about loyalty and friendship.
skipIf: you dislike historical liberties or want modern characters and attitudes.

pairings.reason: The author's other masterpiece, which has a more focused plot and a darker, more patient hero.
A comic fairy tale with the same love of swordplay, friendship and daring rescues.
A shorter, classic adventure with just as much energy and a memorable cast of rogues.
